tagline.zh: 跨文件加功能，用 Plan 模式稳着来
tagline.en: A multi-file feature, done calmly with Plan mode

story.zh: 产品经理要给 todo 加「优先级」，还贴心地写好了验收测试 test/priority.test.js。改动会涉及存储、格式化和命令行三个文件。
story.en: The PM wants priorities in the todo app and has kindly written the acceptance tests in test/priority.test.js. The change touches storage, formatting and the CLI.

goal.zh: 先让 Qoder 出计划，你审过再让它实现，最后验收测试全绿。
goal.en: Get a plan from Qoder, review it, then let it build until the acceptance tests pass.

openingPrompt.zh: 我要给这个 todo 应用加优先级功能，验收标准在 test/priority.test.js。先读代码，给我一个分步实现计划，列出要改哪些文件。先不要改任何代码
openingPrompt.en: I want to add priorities to this todo app. The acceptance criteria are in test/priority.test.js. Read the code and give me a step-by-step plan listing which files change. Don't modify any code yet

hint.zh: 读一读它的计划。小技巧：按 Shift+Tab 可以切换权限模式，输入 /plan 进入 Plan 模式，那时它只读不写。
hint.en: Read the plan. Tip: Shift+Tab cycles permission modes and /plan enters Plan mode, where Qoder reads but never writes.

hint.zh: 给计划提个意见，像审同事的方案一样。
hint.en: Push back on the plan like you would with a teammate.

prompt.zh: 计划里加一条：cli.js 的 add 命令要支持 --priority 参数
prompt.en: Add one thing to the plan: the add command in cli.js should accept a --priority flag

hint.zh: 计划没问题了，放手让它干。
hint.en: Plan looks good. Let it build.

prompt.zh: 计划没问题，开始实现。不要改测试文件，做完跑 node --test
prompt.en: The plan is good, go ahead. Don't change the test files, and run node --test when done

label.zh: 验收测试没被动过手脚
label.en: The acceptance tests weren't tampered with
